001package bank;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.time.LocalDateTime;
005import java.util.Scanner;
006
007import bank.auth.AuthService;
008import bank.model.Account;
009import bank.model.Customer;
010import bank.model.TransactionType;
011import bank.persistence.DataRepository;
012import bank.reporting.StatementGenerator;
013import bank.reporting.TransactionHistory;
014import bank.reporting.TransactionHistory.SearchCriteria;
015import bank.service.InterestCalculator;
016import bank.service.OverdraftPolicy;
017import bank.service.TransactionService;
018
019/**
020 * ============================================================================
021 *  Main.java  —  Entry point for the JJRAM Banking System
022 * ============================================================================
023 *
024 *  TEAM CREDITS:
025 *      Lead / Wiring   : Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
026 *      Services        : Max Pribac          (mpribac@umbc.edu)
027 *      Persistence     : John                (smartdude879@gmail.com)
028 *      Helper / Reviewer: Jordon Tang        (jtang10@umbc.edu)
029 *      Debugger / QA   : Ramya Bommakanti    (ramyab1@umbc.edu)
030 *
031 *  WHAT THIS DOES:
032 *      1. Loads the bank from JSON on startup.
033 *      2. Asks the user to log in (Customer ID + PIN).
034 *      3. Shows a menu loop until they quit.
035 *      4. Saves the bank back to JSON on shutdown.
036 *
037 *  RUN:
038 *      mvn compile
039 *      mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="bank.Main"
040 * ============================================================================
041 */
042public class Main {
043
044    public static void main(String[] args) {
045
046        // ── Wire up the services ─────────────────────────────────────────────
047        DataRepository repo = new DataRepository();
048        repo.load();
049        seedDemoDataIfEmpty(repo);
050
051        AuthService auth = new AuthService(repo);
052        OverdraftPolicy overdraft = new OverdraftPolicy();
053        TransactionService tx = new TransactionService(repo, overdraft);
054        InterestCalculator interest = new InterestCalculator(repo);
055        StatementGenerator statements = new StatementGenerator();
056        TransactionHistory history = new TransactionHistory();
057
058        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
059
060        printWelcome();
061
062        // ── Login loop (3 strikes) ──────────────────────────────────────────
063        Customer current = loginLoop(in, auth);
064        if (current == null) {
065            System.out.println("Goodbye.");
066            return;
067        }
068
069        // ── Menu loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
070        boolean running = true;
071        while (running) {
072            printMenu(current);
073            String choice = in.nextLine().trim();
074
075            try {
076                switch (choice) {
077                    case "1": showAccounts(current); break;
078                    case "2": handleDeposit(in, current, tx); break;
079                    case "3": handleWithdraw(in, current, tx); break;
080                    case "4": handleTransfer(in, current, tx); break;
081                    case "5": handleStatement(current, statements); break;
082                    case "6": handleHistory(in, current, history); break;
083                    case "7":
084                        int n = interest.applyMonthlyInterest();
085                        System.out.println("Monthly interest applied to " + n + " account(s).");
086                        break;
087                    case "0":
088                        running = false;
089                        break;
090                    default:
091                        System.out.println("Unknown option. Try again.");
092                }
093            } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException ex) {
094                System.out.println("[Error] " + ex.getMessage());
095            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
096                System.out.println("[Unexpected error] " + ex.getMessage());
097            }
098        }
099
100        // ── Save and exit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
101        repo.save();
102        System.out.println("Goodbye.");
103    }
104
105    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
106    //  Menu handlers
107    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
108
109    private static void showAccounts(Customer customer) {
110        System.out.println();
111        System.out.println("Accounts for " + customer.getName() + ":");
112        for (Account a : customer.getAccounts()) {
113            System.out.printf("  %-10s  %-9s  Balance: $%,.2f%n",
114                    a.getId(), a.getType(), a.getBalance());
115        }
116    }
117
118    private static void handleDeposit(Scanner in, Customer customer, TransactionService tx) {
119        System.out.print("Account ID: ");
120        String accountId = in.nextLine().trim();
121        System.out.print("Amount: ");
122        BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(in.nextLine().trim());
123
124        tx.deposit(customer, accountId, amount);
125        System.out.println("Deposited $" + amount + " into " + accountId + ".");
126    }
127
128    private static void handleWithdraw(Scanner in, Customer customer, TransactionService tx) {
129        System.out.print("Account ID: ");
130        String accountId = in.nextLine().trim();
131        System.out.print("Amount: ");
132        BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(in.nextLine().trim());
133
134        tx.withdraw(customer, accountId, amount);
135        System.out.println("Withdrew $" + amount + " from " + accountId + ".");
136    }
137
138    private static void handleTransfer(Scanner in, Customer customer, TransactionService tx) {
139        System.out.print("From account ID: ");
140        String fromId = in.nextLine().trim();
141        System.out.print("To account ID: ");
142        String toId = in.nextLine().trim();
143        System.out.print("Amount: ");
144        BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(in.nextLine().trim());
145
146        tx.transfer(customer, fromId, toId, amount);
147        System.out.println("Transferred $" + amount + " from " + fromId + " to " + toId + ".");
148    }
149
150    private static void handleStatement(Customer customer, StatementGenerator statements) {
151        LocalDateTime end = LocalDateTime.now();
152        LocalDateTime start = end.minusMonths(1);
153        statements.generate(customer, start, end);
154    }
155
156    private static void handleHistory(Scanner in, Customer customer, TransactionHistory history) {
157        System.out.print("Filter by type (DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, TRANSFER_OUT, TRANSFER_IN, INTEREST, FEE) or blank for all: ");
158        String typeStr = in.nextLine().trim();
159
160        SearchCriteria criteria = new SearchCriteria();
161        if (!typeStr.isEmpty()) {
162            try {
163                criteria.type(TransactionType.valueOf(typeStr.toUpperCase()));
164            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
165                System.out.println("Unknown type — showing all transactions.");
166            }
167        }
168        history.searchAndPrint(customer, criteria);
169    }
170
171    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
172    //  Login + welcome helpers
173    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
174
175    private static Customer loginLoop(Scanner in, AuthService auth) {
176        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
177            System.out.print("Customer ID: ");
178            String id = in.nextLine().trim();
179            System.out.print("PIN: ");
180            String pin = in.nextLine().trim();
181
182            Customer customer = auth.login(id, pin);
183            if (customer != null) {
184                System.out.println("Welcome, " + customer.getName() + "!");
185                return customer;
186            }
187            int remaining = 3 - attempt;
188            if (remaining > 0) {
189                System.out.println("Invalid login. " + remaining + " attempt(s) remaining.");
190            } else {
191                System.out.println("Too many failed attempts. Exiting.");
192            }
193        }
194        return null;
195    }
196
197    private static void printWelcome() {
198        System.out.println();
199        System.out.println("=================================================");
200        System.out.println("        JJRAM Banking System — v1.0");
201        System.out.println("=================================================");
202    }
203
204    private static void printMenu(Customer current) {
205        System.out.println();
206        System.out.println("--- " + current.getName() + " ---");
207        System.out.println("  1) View accounts");
208        System.out.println("  2) Deposit");
209        System.out.println("  3) Withdraw");
210        System.out.println("  4) Transfer");
211        System.out.println("  5) Print statement (last 30 days)");
212        System.out.println("  6) Transaction history");
213        System.out.println("  7) [Admin] Apply monthly interest");
214        System.out.println("  0) Quit");
215        System.out.print("> ");
216    }
217
218    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
219    //  Demo seed data — populated on first run so the program is usable.
220    //  Default login: id=1001  pin=1234
221    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
222
223    private static void seedDemoDataIfEmpty(DataRepository repo) {
224        if (!repo.allCustomers().isEmpty()) {
225            return;
226        }
227        System.out.println("[Setup] Empty bank — seeding demo customer 1001 (PIN: 1234).");
228        Customer demo = new Customer("1001", "Jane Doe", "1234");
229        demo.addAccount(new bank.model.CheckingAccount(
230                "CHK-1001", new BigDecimal("500.00"), new BigDecimal("100.00")));
231        demo.addAccount(new bank.model.SavingsAccount(
232                "SAV-1001", new BigDecimal("2000.00"), new BigDecimal("0.025")));
233        demo.addAccount(new bank.model.LoanAccount(
234                "LN-1001", new BigDecimal("-5000.00"), new BigDecimal("0.06")));
235        repo.addCustomer(demo);
236        repo.save();
237    }
238}
